evals.prompt: https://github.com/entireio/cli を brew側でインストールして。
evals.expected_output: The agent verifies the tap contents, classifies Entire as a cask rather than a formula, adds entireio/tap to homebrew.taps, adds a tap-qualified cask token to homebrew.casks, and removes any duplicate Nix package if appropriate.

evals.prompt: ripgrep をこのdotfilesに追加して。Nixとbrewのどちらが良いかも確認して。
evals.expected_output: The agent checks existing package lists for duplicates, recognizes ripgrep as a normal CLI available in nixpkgs, recommends Home Manager/Nix package management unless the user explicitly requests brew, and verifies Nix formatting/evaluation after editing.

evals.prompt: 新しいGUIアプリをHomebrew caskで追加して。tapが必要ならそれも含めて。
evals.expected_output: The agent confirms whether the package is a cask, checks whether a third-party tap is required, adds the tap and tap-qualified cask token when needed, and validates that it did not accidentally add a formula entry.
